skills.name: Heavy Boulder (重峦/重巒)
skills.line: The road is blocked. Please turn back.
skills.description: Fukengaku harnesses a giant boulder with the power of a mountain god and smashes it at a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and increases his own RES by 50% after using this skill (lasts for 2 turns).

skills.name: God of Mountain (古山之神/古山の神)
skills.line: Sealed memories echo in the valley.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
While the Hiking Realm is active, whenever an ally gains a Rock Pattern: Cloud's Color stack, Fukengaku gains a Rock Pattern: Cloud stack and whenever an ally gains Rock Pattern: Mountain Views, he gains a Rock Pattern: Mountain stack. ; Rock Pattern：Cloud's Color (峦纹·云衣/巒紋・雲衣) : :'''Buff, Status''': ATK is increased by 200% of Fukengaku's initial DEF (cannot exceed 40% of their initial ATK), lasts for 1 turn. ; Rock Pattern：Cloud (峦纹·云/巒紋・雲) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. Using a normal attack consumes all stacks. Each stack consumed increases all allies' non-crit damage dealt by 3% (max of 15%, cannot exceed 6000% of Fukengaku's initial DEF), lasts for 1 turn. Multiple triggers of this the effect will stack and cause the duration to be refreshed. ; Rock Pattern：Mountain Views (峦纹·山色/巒紋・山色) : :'''Buff, Status''': Gain a shield that can absorb damage equal to 350% of Fukengaku's initial DEF and increases RES by 30%, lasts for 1 turn. ; Rock Pattern：Mountain (峦纹·山/巒紋・山) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. Using a normal attack consumes all stacks. Each stack consumed restores the HP for all allies by 100% of his initial DEF.

upgrades.text: At the start of his own turn, he randomly gains 1 stack of Rock Pattern: Cloud or Rock Pattern: Mountain.
Each time 1 stack of Rock Pattern: Mountain is consumed, 1 debuff or control effect will be dispelled from a random ally, dispelling control effects is prioritised.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically gains 1 stack of Rock Pattern: Clouds and Rock Pattern: Mountain at the start of battle.
Duration for the boost to non-crit damage dealt increases to 2 turns.

skills.name: Mountain Hiking (水宿山行/水宿山行)
skills.line: It's a lovely day. Would you like to go hiking with me?
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
Fukengaku creates a Hiking Realm that lasts for 3 turns. While the realm is active, allies gain Rock Pattern: Cloud's Color at the start of their first turn.
Then, if an ally uses the same skill they used on their last turn, they gain Rock Pattern: Cloud's Color; if they use a different skill or are inflicted with a control effect, they gain Rock Pattern: Mountain Views at the end of their turn. ; Rock Pattern：Cloud's Color (峦纹·云衣/巒紋・雲衣) : :'''Buff, Status''': ATK is increased by 200% of Fukengaku's initial DEF (cannot exceed 40% of their initial ATK), lasts for 1 turn. ; Rock Pattern：Mountain Views (峦纹·山色/巒紋・山色) : :'''Buff, Status''': Gain a shield that can absorb damage equal to 350% of Fukengaku's initial DEF and increases RES by 30%, lasts for 1 turn.

upgrades.text: While in Hiking Realm, allies take 25% less CRIT DMG.
While in Hiking Realm, allies deal 25% more non-CRIT damage.
While the realm is active, the ATK for all allies is increased by 50% of Fukengaku's initial DEF (cannot exceed 20% of the allies' respective initial ATK).
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically uses this skill at the start of battle.

bio.condition: With Fukengaku win 30 times in PVN zones.
